entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait while we connect you to the next available agent.
Hello, thank you for calling VeloFit. My name is Alex. How can I help you today?
Yeah, I need to make a return for a VeloBand.

I can certainly look into that for you. To understand the situation better, could you tell me what specifically is the issue with the VeloBand? Is it a technical fault, or is it more of a preference issue?
There's nothing wrong with it. I just changed my mind.
Okay, thank you for clarifying. I'm pulling up your account now. I see the VeloBand Pulse was delivered 12 days ago. Is that correct?
I guess. I don't use it. It was pretty much an impulse buy and I don't need it.

I understand completely. Sometimes a product doesn't fit into our routine the way we expect. Looking at the policy for the VeloBand Pulse, because it's a device that links directly to a user's personal account upon activation, it has a strict 10-day return window for preference-based returns. Since we're on day 12, I'm afraid I'm unable to process a refund through our system.
Right. Of course. So I'm just stuck with it then?

Not at all. While we can't accept it back as a return due to policy, we do have a very popular option. Many of our customers have great success with our official VeloFit Resale Marketplace. It's a secure platform we host for users to sell gently used gear to other VeloFit enthusiasts.
So your solution is for me to do the work and sell it myself. Wonderful.

It's a great way to recoup most of what you paid, and since it's an official VeloFit community, the resale process is usually very quick and secure. I can email you a direct link to the marketplace page with simple instructions on how to create a listing. Would that be helpful?
Fine. Whatever. Send the link. I guess it's better than a paperweight.
Okay, I've just sent that email to the address on your file. It should arrive in the next few minutes. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
Alright. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and I hope you have a good rest of your day.
